note: Cibola County states it has no zoning ordinance (Ordinance 2020-01 covers only lighting, waste, floodplain permits), so no county zoning layer exists. The City of Grants has a 2012 Land Use Code whose official zoning map is a PDF attachment (Ordinance 12-1197, Attachment B); no city zoning district polygon service was found on grantsnm.gov, the county's ArcGIS Online items, or ArcGIS search. The county's services6 Map_1_2_WFL1 layers include only Grants council districts and boundaries, not zoning. Milan had no zoning layer found. The Anderson Engineering page says city zoning is in a GIS database but publishes no download or service.
